expectations.text: Offers only in-scope levers such as session-length standardization, fixed-point placement and room assignment, without reopening the event's structure
expectations.evidence: Some levers are in scope: standardizing on 30-min slots (option C), a slot grid, and grouping talks into four themed tracks across the rooms. Other parts reopen the event's structure. The grid quietly shortens lunch from the stated 60 min to 45 min and the coffee breaks from 20 min to 15 min, and only one caveat admits the lunch change. Options A and B undo the committee's acceptances by waitlisting 22 or 18 talks. Option D adds a fifth room at 900 USD. The answer also tells speakers that Q&A moves to the hallway. These changes go beyond session length, fixed points and room assignment.
